subject: Marine works - Lake Ontario - Bowmanville
text:
Marine works - Lake Ontario - Bowmanville
Construction and diving operations taking place 24 hours a day southeast of the Darlington Nuclear Generating Station within a 500 metre radius centered on 43 51.695N 078 42.430W. Tugs and barges on site. 
Minimum wake requested and stay clear 800 metres.
                                                    Cancels NW-C-1220-26
